base.name: Shiver Pests
base.visualDescription: Extremely small bug creatures, comparable in design but not based off of Prismite in universe or irl. They are extremely small, and only appear as black dots to the naked eye. However, they may fuse together as little nanobots to do tasks, similarly to ants.

base.name: Shiver Vlogs
base.visualDescription: Based off of Sapphae, however her Sapphire head is instead replaced with a camera, with a great focusing lens.

base.name: Slurpent
